name: WASM Data Packing
definition: Manages WebAssembly memory allocation and data packing for 3D Gaussian splat attributes (positions, rotations, scales, colors, selection) to prepare them for GPU upload or WASM-side processing.
summary: WASM Data Packing serializes JavaScript data into a contiguous WebAssembly heap buffer to minimize GPU transfer overhead, differing from pure GPU-side allocation.
